window.note: PROVED. The allowlist is gone and what replaced it is a property, not a roster: no module the verdict path can REACH — at any depth — may reach a graph tree, port 5432, or a host that could answer. The six dated widenings had one why between them (this module is tree-free), and a list whose every element carries the same reason is a derivation somebody is paying for by hand; the seventh widening was the one nobody paid, and it stood red inside a corpus reported green. THE DISTINCTION WORTH CARRYING IN A YEAR: naming the DENIED capability costs the innocent nothing, so the closure may grow freely while the set sits still — that is the bet, and it is not provable today, which is why it left here as a probe and not as a criterion. TWO THINGS THIS VOYAGE MEASURED AND WAS WRONG ABOUT BEFORE IT MEASURED THEM. (1) I predicted _SOLE_PATH already covered the inference host, so the fire-path rule need not name it. Planting import cairn.devices.inference_domain.route leaves _SOLE_PATH GREEN — inference_domain is precisely the component permitted to dial — while the verdict path gains the ability to ask an LLM. The two rules ask different questions: WHO MAY DIAL versus WHAT THE VERDICT MAY REACH, and the second is not implied by the first. (2) I predicted the new sieve would mirror sole_path_holds exactly, including its per-row attribution. It does not, and the deciding observation was a red rather than an argument: attributing per row rebuilt a 243-file graph 24 times, added 22s to every inspection and timed out this component own proof. Re-read afterwards, the analogy was wrong on the merits too — sole_path binds EVERY component, this binds ONE PATH, and that path is build_inspector. Verdict artifact: verdict-20260812T170623-9e99fc374805.json, 7 criteria pass, 8 hypotheses dispositioned (3 killed, 5 confirmed), deposited to the hypothesize tree. Corpus 100 proofs / 100 green / 0 red, twice; the live trouble the-inspectors-allowlist-tooth-is-red-on-an-import-it-never-admitted is closed by this crossing. Left standing and named rather than fixed: reach_of bands stop at the module boundary, so the two tree-walking sieves band 0 and the nest runs the most expensive meshes first; the dynamic-import check still names 5 modules by hand while the closure holds 17; a subprocess dials and imports nothing.
